dominant_breach: automated entitlement fragility under AI, data matching, fraud scoring, and digital identity controls
fastest_washout: benefit denial, suspension, or delay before notice, human review, or emergency continuation

score_mediated_exclusion_gate.note: Digital eligibility systems become an active Gate 17 blocker when automated risk or data matching defeats subsistence claims without notice, explanation, human review, and continuity.

public_benefit_algorithmic_eligibility.note: Comparative AI law, digital-welfare warnings, federal AI governance, and fraud-risk evidence together make public-benefit automation a live claim-conversion surface.

automated_decision_notice_explanation_ap.note: Notice, explanation, human review, and stop-use controls are core proof burdens for high-impact AI and rights-affecting public systems.

identity_verification_access_and_error_c.note: Identity proofing and fraud controls must include assisted/offline paths and timely correction before claim loss.

model_audit_disparate_impact_testing.note: Model risk management exists as a standard, but certification requires decision-level audits and protected-group outcome evidence.

score_repair_claimability.note: Claim repair must restore payment and deadlines, not merely record an appeal after subsistence harm occurs.

proof_debt: benefit denial, suspension, and delay caused by data matches, models, or identity checks
appeal reversal rate and time to restored benefits
public algorithm inventory and high-impact AI risk controls

gate_17_score_mediated_exclusion.why: Gate 17 is blocked: public-benefit automation cannot certify without public algorithm inventories, data-source notices, reasoned explanations, human review, offline/assisted channels, emergency continuation, and subgroup false-positive audits.

evidence_debt_register.question: benefit denial, suspension, and delay caused by data matches, models, or identity checks
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Collect decision-level data separating policy ineligibility from automated/data-match/identity failure.

evidence_debt_register.question: appeal reversal rate and time to restored benefits
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure whether review happens before subsistence harm and whether benefits/deadlines are preserved during appeal.

evidence_debt_register.question: public algorithm inventory and high-impact AI risk controls
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Require agency/vendor inventories, risk determinations, impact assessments, stop-use criteria, and public disclosure.

evidence_debt_register.question: subgroup false-positive and access-channel audits
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Audit outcomes by disability, language, race/ethnicity, income volatility, homelessness/address instability, age, and digital access.

validation_notes: rev0330 promotes this scoreboard from seed to active in the Gate 17 score-mediated-exclusion burndown; certification remains blocked unless correction, explanation, dispute, appeal, and transaction-preservation rails are shown.
